title: Workforce disruption remained widespread
decision_reason: The layoff count is a tracked minimum and GDC percentages describe survey respondents, not the global workforce.

title: Students faced a difficult entry market
statement: Students faced a difficult entry market
decision_reason: Student sentiment and layoffs do not measure actual graduate entry into games work.

title: Capital activity did not establish an employment recovery
statement: Capital activity did not establish an employment recovery
decision_reason: Transactions and layoffs measure different processes; no causal relationship is inferred.

title: Publisher performance remained uneven
decision_reason: Reporting periods, currencies and segment definitions differ, so these observations are not a ranking.
